spread_data: Bid/ask non disponibile da Yahoo OHLC; costi sono sensitività, non spread osservati.
price_basis: Yahoo OHLC auto_adjust=False, actions=True, repair=True; prezzi storici split-adjusted, non necessariamente prezzi nominali originali as-traded.

rules.instrument: Buy-and-hold PAPER on inverse/short ETPs; this is not broker short-selling.
rules.entry: Donchian20 breakout on the inverse ETP plus Walking true at completed close; enter next session open.
rules.stop: Initial stop at entry minus 2 x ATR14 measured at signal close; daily low checked; adverse gap exits at open.
rules.exit: After two consecutive completed closes with Walking false, exit next open; hard cap at close of session 10.
rules.activation: First live run establishes a baseline on latest daily candle; no historical trades fabricated.
